[image: #Ready to knock some doors and help elect Democrats across Spokane County? Join Carmela Conroy, Callie Gee, Julia Payne, Elliot Robison, and volunteers from across the area for a Spokane Coalition Canvass in Medical Lake this Sunday! Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never knocked a door before, we’ll make sure you have what you need to get started. Bring a friend, meet fellow volunteers, and help us reach voters where it matters most—right at their doors. 📅 Sunday, September 20 ⏰ 11:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m. 📍 Medical Lake We need you. Sign up today using the QR code or here: https://www.mobilize.us/conroyforcongress/event/1035813/ and join us Sunday! #Volunteer #Canvass #SpokaneCounty #EasternWashington #wa05 #conroy4congress]

[image: A few weekends ago, Team Eastern Washington joined Walla Walla Frontier Days Parade, and what a welcome! Neighbors on both sides of the street, kids waving, people stopping us to say what they need from their representative in DC. This is how you earn a district – one conversation at a time. Thank you, Walla Walla!]

[image: Are you ready to knock on some doors and help elect great progressive candidates across Spokane County? Join Carmela Conroy, Callie Gee, Rob Tupper, Michaela Kelso, Julia Payne, Elliot Robison, Danny Tarkenton and volunteers from across the area for our Spokane Coalition Canvasses! Whether you’re an experienced canvasser or have never knocked a door before, we’ll make sure you have what you need to get started. [image: Canvassing and tabling opportunities are available. If you're in Pend Orielle county, I'll be at the next Pend Orielle county Democrats fundraiser! See you out there! #conroy4congress #wa05]
[image: Carmela Conroy for Congress]

[image: Days at the Spokane County Interstate Fair, one folding table, an issues spinner wheel, and hundreds of conversations. We talked with lifelong Democrats, lifelong Republicans, and a lot of people who told us they had stopped paying attention. That last group is toughest to reach, but all of our voices matter. Thank you to the Spokane County Democrats and every volunteer who took a shift in that hall. Showing up where people already are beats any ad we could buy.]

[image: Delighted to speak with the Retired Public Employees Council of Washington at their chapter lunch, and to do it at the Longhorn Barbecue. My parents used to take me there before I flew off to overseas assignments, so walking back in felt deeply nostalgic. RPEC members spent their careers serving Washington – in our schools, our hospitals, our cities and our state agencies. They earned their pensions and their health care, and I will defend both in Congress. Retirement security is not a line item. It is a promise. Thank you to RPEC for the invitation, and for the questions – this group does its homework.]

[image: Do you want a Conroy for Congress Yard Sign? Signs can be picked up, during office hours, at our Spokane Campaign HQ, 1106 N. Washington St., Suite B, or the Walla Walla County Democrats office, location and hours at https://www.wallawallademocrats.com Outside of these areas or would like a sign delivered? Contact: volcoord@conroy4congress.com]

[image: Dog day at HQ, and he should have been here. Our volunteers brought their best coworkers, the phones still got dialed, and nobody left without a treat. Come by, bring your (well-socialized) dog, take a clipboard: https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Donald Trump just posted a video attacking me by name as a "dumb-o-crat" and giving Michael Baumgartner his "Complete and Total Endorsement." Trump does not get involved in a race until his party is in trouble. Eastern Washington has his attention because we put this seat in play, and people here are done being taken for granted. But when Trump weighs in, the money follows. This endorsement always brings a surge of cash. I don't have an army of billionaires with an endless supply of dark money. I have you. I spent my career as a prosecutor and a diplomat. I am not intimidated by a man who thinks a social media post decides an election. Help me make sure voters here get the facts instead of Trump's version of them – and we'll win this: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cc-soc-2609]

[image: Eastern Washington, we’ve got a busy week ahead! 🎉 From Newport to Airway Heights, Lewiston, and Liberty Lake, Carmela will be out meeting voters, canvassing with local candidates, and connecting with supporters across the region. Check out the upcoming events below, grab a friend, and come join us! 💙 We’d love to see you there! Volunteer and donate at www.conroy4congress.com]

[image: Grateful to the Walla Walla County Democrats for having us at their County Fair booth!. Local volunteers do the unglamorous work – tabling in the heat, signing up volunteers, talking with neighbors nobody has asked for their vote in years. If you are in Walla Walla and want in, we have a place for you: https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Great to spend the evening at the Friends of the Liberty Lake Municipal Library Summer Soirée, supporting the heart of one of the fastest-growing towns in #WA05. Thanks to Mark and his team at Liberty Lake Wine Cellars for hosting this community event and for the tour!]

[image: Hillyard Pride, and our table was one of the busiest in the park – thanks largely to the volunteers who staffed it and the campaign dog who held down the chair. Eastern Washington is a place where people look after each other. Pride here is neighbors, kids, dogs on leashes, and a community where everyone belongs. I am proud to stand with it, in Hillyard and in Congress.]

[image: Honored to earn the endorsement of @nwpc_national! In Congress, I’ll always advocate for women’s rights—from protecting reproductive freedom to fighting for equal pay, affordable child care, and support for survivors.]

[image: Honored to earn the endorsement of the @allianceforgunresponsibility Victory Fund. Every family deserves to feel safe at school, at work, in their place of worship, and in their neighborhood. In Congress, I’ll fight for common-sense gun safety to protect our communities.]

[image: If you haven't voted yet, today is the day! Return your completed ballot to an official drop box by 8pm. Need a replacement ballot in Ferry, Spokane, or Stevens County? Contact your County Elections or Auditor’s Office right away. Stay safe, and let's get out there and vote.‌‌💙]

[image: It's going to be a busy weekend in WA05! Carmela will be at the EWU Neighborfest in Cheney on Friday and there will be canvassing Friday, Saturday and Sunday, in Cheney, Deer Park and Spokane Valley. We need volunteers to staff the Conroy 4 Congress Table at Valley Fest on Saturday and Sunday. To sign up for a shift for two visit www.conroy4congress.com/volunteer/]

[image: Join Carmela for a cup of coffee and a conversation about what matters most to you! She'll be at the locations below from 8:30–9:15 a.m. on the following dates: ☕ Wednesday, July 29 - Arctos Coffee and Roasting Co., 1923 N. Hamilton St., Spokane ☕ Friday, July 31 - Little Garden Cafe, 9818 Waikiki Rd., Spokane See you there!!]

[image: Join our Election Night Gathering with Team Conroy for Congress! Come gather with our team, connect with fellow supporters, and watch the election results roll in with us at BrickWest Brewing (1318 W. 1st Ave.) from 6:00–9:00 PM.]

[image: Lanterns over the water, neighbors on the lawn, and not one dollar from a corporate PAC. Tonight at midnight the fundraising quarter closes. This is the last report before ballots go in the mail, and it is the number every political reporter and every DC group will use to decide whether Eastern Washington is worth taking seriously. They already decided Trump's endorsement was worth spending on. Let's show them what neighbors chipping in looks like instead: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cc-soc-2609]

[image: Nearly 300 people participated in person at the #WA05 forum at Whitman College in Walla Walla, and they came with real questions about affordability, health care, and datacenters. Thanks to AAUW Walla Walla and Northwest Public Broadcasting for hosting the forum, and Rasa Vineyards and the Network of Exceptional Women for the after party. We'll be back!]

[image: Now that is craftsmanship. Volunteers across Eastern Washington are building and planting signs on their own land, on their own time, because they want a representative who actually shows up here. Thank you for this one – it is a beauty. Want a sign of your own? https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: One of our canvassers knocked on a door in Spokane and left with a loaf of banana bread. This is the part of campaigning that never makes the news. Someone gives up a Saturday, walks a neighborhood, and gets a real conversation and a sweet treat out of it. That is how you win a district Washington, D.C. wrote off. Thank you for the bread, and for the welcome. Want to come with us? https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Porchfest is Spokane at its best – neighbors on lawns, music on porches, strangers turning into friends by the third song. Thank you to everyone who stopped to talk with us between sets. Being out in community is the best part of being a candidate.]
[image: Proud to be endorsed by the @wwcountydems! Looking forward to coordinating grassroots work to unseat our freshman representative and bring more problem-solving, less politics to #WA05.]

[image: Proud to earn the endorsement of the @wastonewalldems! Everyone deserves the freedom to be who they are, and equal protection under the law. #LoveIsLove and reproductive freedom, civil rights, and mutual respect make our communities stronger.]

[image: Rush hour at Five Mile Plaza, and this is what our campaign looks like: neighbors on a corner, signs in hand, waving at people they have known for thirty years. Nobody paid them. Nobody bused them in. They decided this seat is worth standing on a sidewalk for. If you have ever wanted to help but did not know where to start, this is where to start: https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Spotted downtown: a Silverado with an Air Force plate, a lumber rack, and a Carmela Conroy sign strapped across the back. This campaign does not run on billionaires. It runs on veterans, tradespeople, and neighbors who put our name on their own truck and their own front lawn. Every one of these is somebody publicly announcing their decision. Want one? https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Strong leadership starts with listening. That's why Carmela is committed to showing up in every corner of our district and having conversations with every community. Thank you to the Ferry County Republican Party for hosting a #WA05 candidate forum in #Republic!]

[image: Team Conroy had a blast waving signs, meeting neighbors, and marching in the parade at the annual #Cheney Rodeo Parade! Nothing beats the energy of neighbors coming together to celebrate their community! 🐴]

[image: Team Conroy had a wonderful time at the Browne's Addition Concert Series in Coeur d'Alene Park! 🎶 Want to enjoy an evening of live music, connect with neighbors, and meet our team? Join us at the next concert tomorrow, July 9. We hope to see you there! #Spokane]

[image: Thank you to everyone who joined Carmela and Team Conroy at BrickWest Brewing on Election Night! With votes still being counted, we're encouraged by the results and energized for the work ahead - join the movement today at conroy4congress.com 💪]

[image: Thank you to the Riverview Retirement Community for the warm welcome at our Democracy Discussion, and to Ken Pelo for the invite! Seniors across #WA05 are concerned about cuts to Social Security and Medicare and deserve a Representative who will protect those promises.]

[image: Thank you to the Skeims for opening their home to us. A living room full of neighbors, real questions about health care and the cost of living, and no talking points. I would take one of these over a rally any day – you cannot dodge a question in someone's kitchen. If you want to host one before ballots go out, we will bring the buttons: https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Thank you to the Stevens County Democrats for the warm welcome in Chewelah, and to everyone who came out to talk and then headed out to knock doors with us. Rural Eastern Washington is not a flyover on my map – it is the job. Want to canvass with us? https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Thanks to everyone who came out to the @spokesmanreview and Northwest Passages-sponsored #WA05 congressional debate to hear from the candidates, meet Carmela, and discuss the issues that matter most to Eastern WA.]

[image: The Garfield County Democrats set up at the fair with a flip chart and one question: what matters to you this election? Look at what people wrote in. Social Security. Health care. Gas and diesel prices. Food prices. Farming costs. Education. Misinformation. No forever wars. Data centers, and guardrails on AI. Not one person walked up and said culture war. People in Garfield County are worried about the cost of running a household and a farm, and about being told a story instead of the truth. That list is my agenda. Thank you to the Garfield County Democrats for asking the question.]
[image: The writing is on the wall. Literally. #FlipWA05 Let's do this, Eastern Washington.]

[image: There’s a lot happening across Eastern Washington! Carmela is heading to Walla Walla, Spokane, and Spokane Valley, with two upcoming candidate forums and plenty of opportunities to get involved. Check out this week’s events flyer and find a way to join Team Eastern Washington — whether you’re ready to canvass, phone bank, table, or wave signs! Election Day is getting closer. Let’s finish strong!]

[image: VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES!!! If you’ve been thinking about volunteering with Conroy for Congress, now is the time! With Election Day getting closer, there are more ways than ever to help Carmela & local candidates across our community. 🏠 Knock doors with a canvassing team — training is provided, so no experience is necessary. ☎️ Make phone calls from campaign headquarters or from the comfort of home. 👋 Looking for something a little smaller? Wave signs, staff the campaign office, or help at Carmela’s information table at a local event. Whether you have a few hours or want to get involved regularly, there’s a place for you on this campaign. Pick what works for you and sign up today: www.conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: Valleyfest weekend, sharing a booth with "Rational Rob" Tupper, candidate for the 4th LD. We enjoyed lots of good conversations about what people in Spokane Valley need from their representatives. Thanks to everyone who showed up!]

[image: Washington's Primary is less than a month away, and ballots hit mailboxes July 17! Check out the #WAPrimary voter guide, make sure your registration is up to date, and read Carmela's voter pamphlet statement at the link in bio!]

[image: We deserve a representative who is accountable to us - not to corporate PACs and extreme elites. That's why I have taken the @politicalintegrity.us pledge to reject corporate PAC $, ban stock trading in Congress, close the revolving door on lobbying, and overturn Citizens United. #WA05 Graphic via @politicalintegrity.us]

[image: We stopped by Masters Brewhouse in Deer Park on the way home from canvassing in Chewelah, and folks who had seen me at the WA-05 candidate forum waved us over. We talked rising costs, high school sports, and what Eastern Washington needs from its representative in DC.]

[image: With just 6 days to go until Primary Election Day, help Team Conroy spread the word! Join friends and neighbors for a fun sign-waving event to support Carmela's campaign for Congress. Bring your energy, your smile, and let's show Eastern WA we're ready for change! 🔗 in bio!]

[image: Yard signs are flying out the door and new canvassers signing up! Two months from Election Day, this is what it looks like when a district decides it is not sitting this one out. Want a sign, or a door-knocking or phone-banking shift? Sign up at https://conroy4congress.com/volunteer]

[image: 📣 This Sunday, July 19, Team Conroy is coming together for our Canvass, Cookout & Community Event! With Primary ballots going out THIS WEEK, we need your help reaching voters across Eastern WA. Join us for an afternoon of action, food, and fun! Sign up link in bio!]
